notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Thanks for the early feedback. We have fixed some bugs which were annoying and needed to go.



Fixes:
[olist]
Graphical issue where some area of certain buildings were flickering.

Fixed objects which appeared to be floating.

Fixed one AI which was behaving not as intended.

Updated Shadow options which provides more detailed shadows

Few other minor fixes.
[/olist]


Thank you for playing Wiped Clean. Hope you will have lots of fun :)

notes.title: Patch - June 20th, 2025
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Thanks for the early feedback. We have fixed some bugs which were annoying and needed to go.

Fixes:

-Graphical issue where some area of certain buildings were flickering.
-Fixed objects which appeared to be floating.

-Updated Shadow options which provides more detailed shadows

Thank you for playing Wiped Clean. Hope you will have lots of fun :)

notes.title: Wiped Clean Out NOW
notes.content:
Wiped Clean is finally available to play! — and we couldn’t have done it without YOU.From the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU for every wishlist, every comment, every bit of hype and encouragement along the way. Your support means everything.We’re super excited (and a little nervous) to finally share this experience with you all.

We can’t wait to hear what you think. Let’s uncover the truth — and survive the darkness — together.
